title: Manchester United: the Touchline Take on the transfer talk
body:
Sky Sports has a transfer story involving Manchester United [S1]. The headline said it plainly: “Merson: Man Utd transfer policy is to blame - not Carrick” [S1]. The names in the frame: Paul Merson and Michael Carrick [S1].

For context, BBC Sport also ran: “The Monaco summit that will decide the future of Carrick and Man Utd” [S2]. In our Football-Data.co.uk results, Manchester United have 0 wins, 3 draws and 2 defeats from their last 5 league games: 3 points, 6 scored and 11 conceded [ST1].

If this one goes through, it says plenty about where the club thinks it is heading. The smart money is on patience: rushed deals rarely age well. The Touchline Take: judge the business when the window shuts, not before.

evidence.text: Sky Sports: Merson: Man Utd transfer policy is to blame - not Carrick. Sky Sports' Paul Merson believes Manchester United’s transfer strategy is to blame for their worst start to a top-flight season instead of head coach Michael Carrick.
